name: gmail
title: Gmail
description: Your Gmail: a Google sign-in, or an address and an app password (IMAP and SMTP).
needed_for: Reads your Gmail inbox into conversations.
justification: A Gmail data source reads the mailbox over IMAP and sends over SMTP as you. Sign in with Google, or give an app password — Google never accepts the account password.

GMAIL_SIGNIN.label: Sign in with Google
GMAIL_SIGNIN.hint: One click: reads and sends as the Google account you sign in with.

GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.label: App password
GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.hint: Needs 2-Step Verification on. Google shows it in four groups of four letters.

signin.label: Sign in with Google
signin.hint: One click, no password to create.

app.label: App password
app.hint: An address and an app password from your Google account (needs 2-Step Verification).
